facts.headline: South Korea Wildfires 2025, Deadliest in Nation's History
facts.summary: The South Korea wildfires 2025 became the deadliest in the nation's history — at least 28 dead, 37,000 displaced, and the 1,300-year-old Gounsa Temple lost. Officials frame it as a seasonal event, but eight of the last ten years rank among the warmest on record, and these conditions are now the baseline.
